title: Acceptance condition for a configuration
statement: Let $M$ be a finite Turing machine with Boolean tape symbols, let $n,s\in\mathbb{N}$, let $x$ be a finite Boolean input, and let $c$ be a configuration of $M$ on input $x$. The acceptance formula evaluated on the Boolean code of $c$ is true if and only if $c$ is in the halting state and its output is exactly the one-symbol list $[\mathrm{true}]$.
hypotheses_covered: A finite Turing machine $M$ with Boolean symbols
